more.def: A particular time when something happens, or a special event.
examples: A birthday is a special occasion.
On one occasion, we saw a deer in the yard.
We wear nice clothes for special occasions.
When did the storm occur?
Floods occur in spring.
The accident occurred at noon.

more.def: To take place or happen, often without warning.
examples: The eclipse will occur on Tuesday.
Storms often occur in the late afternoon.
A good idea occurred to her while she was walking.

easy.def: A very big sea of salt water.
examples: Whales live in the ocean.
We swim in the ocean.
The ocean is very deep.

more.def: One of the huge bodies of salt water that cover most of the Earth.
examples: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean in the world.
Sea turtles travel across the ocean to lay eggs.
From the plane, the ocean looked endless.
Halloween is in October.
Leaves turn orange in October.
We pick pumpkins in October.

more.def: The tenth month of the year, when leaves change color in many places.
examples: We carve pumpkins at the end of October.
October brings crisp air and bright red leaves.
Geese fly south in October.
